name: invideo CLI
desc: Terminal video editor that coding agents drive with shell commands.
desc_zh: 让编程 Agent 用命令行操作的专业视频编辑器。
solves: An agent can write a script but cannot cut a video; this gives it real timeline commands and writes the exports straight to disk.
solves_zh: Agent 能写脚本却剪不了片子；给它真正的 timeline 命令，导出文件直接落到磁盘上。
best_for: You already work in Claude Code or Codex and want the finished video on your own filesystem.
best_for_zh: 你本来就在 Claude Code 或 Codex 里干活，想让成片直接落到自己磁盘上。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — invideo product directory reached from the homepage nav (https://invideo.io/）。 First public release is tag v0.1.0, published 2026-10-23T15:42:24Z by the official invideoio/cli repository; v0.1.1–v0.1.3 followed on 2026-10-26, 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03. The human-readable GitHub release page renders the date as '23 Oct 15:42' with the year only in the page's machine-readable timestamp, which is why the API URL is quoted as a second evidence entry. The CLI is a distinct entry point from the ledger record invideo-ai (the prompt-to-video web flow at invideo.io/ai): it is one native binary driven from a shell, and the vendor's own comparison page describes the CLI and the MCP server as two different ways into the same editor. Requires an invideo account sign-in; there are no API keys by design. 首次公开日期来源：https://github.com/invideoio/cli/releases/tag/v0.1.0
